annotate.Annotation Overlay: captures the point and its comment
annotate.Video Player and Scrubber: supplies the presented frame's media time the point is anchored on (ADR-0002)
annotate.Annotations: one-shot idempotent create, success only after commit
annotate.PostgreSQL Database: Annotation table, constraints and index must exist for the durable save

panel.Feedback Panel: chronological list, same-pixel marker badges, same-frame grouping, 5 s polling
panel.Video Player and Scrubber: seek-and-pause on a frame or loop a range on click

thread.Replies and Status: one reply (unique constraint, 409) and status transition with declared role
thread.PostgreSQL Database: Reply table with unique annotation_id, status/resolved_at/resolved_role columns

queue-assign.Review Queue Screen: per-row editor picker and independent status control
queue-assign.Review Queue: assign exactly one editor, set row status, never derived
queue-assign.Editors: pool of named editors for the picker
queue-assign.PostgreSQL Database: ReviewQueueEntry status check and editor FK, Editor table (BR-003 by constraint)

register.Review Queue: registers a video already in storage, enforces row-points-at-existing-video
register.PostgreSQL Database: new ReviewQueueEntry row with unique video_id FK

integ-data.Client Metadata Adapter: second implementation reading the client data store, local fallback
integ-data.Editors: hand-seeded pool replaced by a read from the client store
integ-data.Review Queue: rows and registration switch to sourcing client name/editor/location through the adapter (C4: queue -> metadataAdapter)

key_changes: Initially placed Client Metadata Adapter under register (C4 shows queue -> metadataAdapter pre-fill, local impl is the base case). Both sets instead put the queue-to-adapter wiring under integ-data via Review Queue, which is a defensible FR-033 placement and avoids double-counting; moved Review Queue into integ-data and dropped the adapter from register.

Accepted as optional (neither required nor wrong): Principal Middleware on annotate/thread, Media Bucket on register, Video Catalogue on panel, Review Web App only when it claims no work owned by a child component.

wrong_reasons.X.integ-data.Review Queue Screen: §6 Client Metadata Adapter invariant: the queue and register form never depend on the client side; the adapter swaps implementations behind one interface, so the screen is unchanged
wrong_reasons.Y.annotate.Review Web App: container, not a component; its why claims sending the create, which C4 assigns to Annotation Overlay -> Annotations, so the same work is claimed twice

patterns: X never links PostgreSQL Database, so the table, constraint and migration work behind durable save, one-reply, one-editor and register goes unseen (4 misses).
X lets a UI component ride along on a backend-only integration change (Review Queue Screen on integ-data) despite the adapter's one-interface invariant.
Y links a container alongside its own child component and claims the child's work (Review Web App on annotate).
Y's why for Video Player and Scrubber on panel credits it with drawing count badges, which §6 gives to Feedback Panel; the link stands on its seek/loop reason, so not counted.
Y links Principal Middleware on annotate and thread but not on the other API-backed features; correct per §6 but inconsistent, so not counted.
